statements.sql: SELECT path, sha2(content, 256) = content_sha256 AS hash_ok FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND path IN ('docs/index.md', 'docs/quick-start.md') ORDER BY path
UPDATE workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs SET content = content || ' ' WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND path = 'docs/index.md'

INSERT INTO workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs SELECT source_repo, version_tag, commit_sha, path, content, content_sha256, size_bytes, ingested_at, 'm1-dup-test' FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND path = 'docs/quick-start.md'

SELECT path, count(*) AS rows, count_if(sha2(content, 256) <> content_sha256) AS hash_mismatches FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND path IN ('docs/index.md', 'docs/quick-start.md') GROUP BY path ORDER BY path
SELECT version, operation FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 3
